task.title: Relics: a failed relic push must not hide task push errors
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M5). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

A push sends the task refs first and the relic refs second. When the relic push fails on the wire after the task push worked, the whole push phase is marked failed. The task errors of the same run (`rejected`, `invalid`, `local-changed`) are then hidden, although the task items are kept.

## Wanted

Keep the push phase completed, keep the relic error, and return it after the task errors.

## Done when

- A run with a rejected task and a relic push that fails on the wire reports both, in text and in JSON.
- The exit code for that run is documented in the reference.
